title: Ayahuasca Retreat
description: Experience a powerful, heart-opening journey with traditional ayahuasca ceremonies held in a safe, supportive environment. Our facilitators guide you through inner realms of healing, clarity and transformation with careful integration before, during and after each ceremony.

title: Cacao Retreat
description: Ceremonial cacao opens the heart and awakens the senses. This retreat blends tradition with movement, music, and mindfulness to help release emotional blockages, foster self-love, and experience deep joy in community connection.

title: Health & Wellness Retreat
description: This retreat is designed to restore your vitality. Through nourishing food, mindful movement, breathwork and healing modalities, you’ll leave feeling stronger, lighter and aligned with your healthiest self.
